nom: Particle for Men Particle Face Mask For Men

segments.mature: Reviewers, many in their 60s, 70s, and even pushing 80, report smoother, tighter, firmer skin with reduced pore size and fewer wrinkles after using this mask weekly, several noting people no longer guess their real age.

concerns.aging: Reviewers across a wide age range report visibly fewer fine lines and wrinkles and tighter-looking skin after weeks to months of weekly use, with several receiving compliments on looking younger; one reviewer also credits it with fading dark age spots and acne scars.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the mask reduced redness marks left on his nose from a past MRSA infection, and another reports fewer light red spots on the skin after seven weeks of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the mask helped fade dark brown age spots along with acne scars, though this is the only report addressing pigmentation directly among the reviews supplied.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer credits the mask with clearing acne scars, though this is the only report addressing acne directly among the reviews supplied.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels tight during and after application
Quick and easy to apply and rinse off
Small amount needed, jar lasts a long time
Often paired with matching face cream for best results

extraits.texte: I thought I probably waited to long to begin self-care for my skin (I am in my 60's). But when I found Particle face and neck cream I hit the lottery. People always say I don't look my age. So, I have continued through the line and each product has surpassed my expectations. This is true for the Face Mask as well. My wife has always used one so, why not try? Boom! noticeable results withing the first month. I really like how my my pores have been reduced and my skin feels smoother. They have another winner.

So I have used once a week for a couple weeks and I definitely notice a tangible difference in the way my skin feels amd looks first my complexion looks really good the large pores I had have shrunk a little bit and it exfoliate my face making it soft amd smooth also cleaned out all the gunk in my pores I would recommend to use this product along with the face wash and the 6 in 1 face cream.i have alore less wrinkles the bags under my eyes are gone and I just look healthier and younger

I've been using Particle for a few months now and recently purchased the Face Mask. Just like the other Particle products, you can see and feel the quality of this great men's formula. I'm 73 and I realized that my skin has aged, but with Particle, I know that I look the best that I can possibly be.

I use the face mask as directed. After using it for 7 weeks my complexion has improved eliminating some of the light red spots I have. It's smooth feeling doesn't feel like some other applications that felt abrasive. Will definitely make this a weekly application.

extraits.titre: FACIAL MASKS ARE FOR MEN TOO !
extraits.texte: I never thought I would use a facial mask. Then I found Particle facial mask. It smells great and seems to firm up the skin. The best part is that people can not believe that I am 70 years old. That is worth the price of the mask.
I use this product every evening. It has reduced the redness marks I have on my nose from a previous bout with MRSA. I have tried numerous products with negative results.
It works! It removes fine wrinkles, dark brown age spots and acne scars.
